initial_prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Input image is an exact 5 columns x 3 rows animation pose/layout guide, D01-D15 read left-right top-bottom. Create a 3000x2400 or larger 5x3 production drawing sheet. Redraw EACH of its 15 faceted mannequins as the SAME original Japanese 2D anime cel character with sophisticated volumetric drawing, clean controlled ink, restrained 2-tone shadows, oversized matte black hood always up, face entirely hidden in rear three-quarter view, charcoal cargo pants, black sneakers, exactly one plain angular rectangular black backpack with fixed proportions and exactly two shoulder straps. No logos, weapons, lights, glow, extra straps or decorations. Preserve each guide panel's exact camera, character scale, hip/head positions, planted shoe coordinates, movement direction, and limb pose; no recentering or resizing across panels. The guide's movement travels rightward across each successive panel, first compresses then pushes into short airborne lateral dodge, then lands and compresses. Add coherent fabric folds at knee/elbow compression and slight trailing hood and hem lag; preserve backpack volume. This is animation cleanup over an exact 3D guide, not 15 unrelated illustrations. Improve anatomy and hood shape while preserving pose registration. Flat uniform background RGB 187,193,201 in all panels, NO grid, shadows, scenery, captions, dividing lines or labels. Fill same panel area as guide. Every drawing full body. Do not imitate any named franchise or artist.
correction_prompt: Edit target Image 1, the 5x3 fifteen-drawing black-hooded character animation sheet. Supporting Image 2 is the exact 3D pose guide. Preserve all character design, blank rectangular black backpack, two straps, black hood up, no visible face, no glow, rendering style and panel arrangement. Correct ONLY last row panels 3, 4 and 5 (D13 D14 D15): both shoes must be firmly planted, with the character's LEFT foot on SCREEN RIGHT and lower in image and the RIGHT support foot on SCREEN LEFT and slightly higher, as in supporting guide. Keep each hip and head position unchanged, adjust knees and pant folds coherently to reach those planted feet. This corrects crossed/merged feet and stabilizes settling. Keep first 12 drawings unchanged as closely as possible. Keep uniform light gray background. No new text, no new objects. Maintain exactly 5 columns x3 rows. Return high resolution if supported.
